_comment: Toolchain pin for every layout/ evidence directory (issue #46).
Same shape as the sibling 2AMLogic/sky130-trng layout/pdk.json, whose
compose-cell.py recipe layout/bin/ is ported from (commit 5d443907).
variant           sky130 flavor used to generate/verify layout/
open_pdks_commit  MUST equal sim/gm-id-characterization/pdk.json's
(c6d73a35f524..., verified 2026-10-09); enforced by
layout/bin/compose-cell.py against `klt pdk find`.
klt_deck          --deck for every klt drc / extract / lvs call
klt_version       `klt version --format json` .version of the build
that produced the committed evidence
klt_commit        its .git_commit; compose-cell.py refuses to run on
any other build unless --allow-unpinned is given.
This is a source commit, not a tagged release (no
PyPI artifact carries it), and it is NEWER than the
sibling's 5edb557f (0.6.0+g5edb557f91d0), the
curator's candidate pin. Chosen because it is the
build this worker fleet provisions (so the evidence
was produced and re-checked on it directly); both
contain the reference.deck-aware bare-literal unit
fix (klayout-tools#1492/#1505) this flow relies on
to pass design/ device cards through verbatim.
klt_install       a throwaway environment that runs exactly this
build without touching any host-wide install
